title: Calyx
subtitle: Public sculpture generated from leaf-venation systems
coverAlt: Calyx public sculpture at the University of Rochester
summary: Calyx is a public sculpture commissioned by the University of Rochester that translates biological organization into a generative design and fabrication process.
body: Custom leaf-venation algorithms generated three-dimensional branching patterns that grow, connect, thicken, and stabilize across a surface, producing an open lattice that expands from a compact base into a canopy-like form.
Geometry optimization translated the branching network into individual stainless-steel plates that could be cut, welded, and bolted into an architectural-scale campus landmark.
